build.note: No editor was launched. Every frame below is a real-RHI D3D12 render from the packaged exe.

recipe.why: The editor cannot render on this box; the packaged Development build can, and it can be driven with zero foreground focus.
recipe.launch: start detached: <exe> -windowed -ResX=1600 -ResY=900 -nosplash -nosteam -notraceserver -notrace -noverifygc -ini:Game:<overrides> -ExecCmds="Ghost,BugItGo X Y Z Pitch Yaw Roll"
recipe.capture: PostMessage WM_KEYDOWN/WM_KEYUP to the game HWND: F2 enters photo mode, F9 writes a 2x (3840x2160) PNG to <launchDir>/MikdashPhotos. HighResShot-based, so no UI is in the image.
gotchas: bEnabled=False on the front end is WRONG: MikdashPlayerController::BeginPlay then opens the legacy walkthrough menu. Use bShowMainMenuOnBoot=False instead.

-notraceserver stops the Unreal trace control port from raising a Windows Firewall prompt. A leftover elevated firewall dialog holds the foreground and cannot be dismissed by a non-elevated process; PostMessage input works anyway.

PostMessage delivers DISCRETE key bindings (F2, F9, V) because those route through UGameViewportClient::InputKey. It does NOT drive photo-mode WASD flight or console text entry, which need real Slate keyboard focus. Place the camera with BugItGo instead.
Ghost before BugItGo keeps the pawn from falling when teleporting to unstreamed terrain.
BugItGo appears to leave a thin black sliver of the player mesh near the camera; frames 01 and 02 (no teleport) are free of it.

cookedBuildMaterialFallbacks.source: Saved/Logs/MikdashCourtyardV3.log, LogMaterial warnings on every launch of this build
missingFlags: bUsedWithInstancedStaticMeshes (vegetation and city detail, placed on HISM)
cookedBuildMaterialFallbacks.whyThisPassedEveryPriorCheck: The editor silently adds a missing usage flag at runtime and only warns that the asset needs resaving. Parameter parity, reopen checks and -nullrhi receipts therefore all stay green while the cooked build falls back to the default material.

scope: Visual acceptance of ten framed views. NOT performance, audio, route, interaction or navmesh acceptance.
